DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL).

The combination of severe leg pain, fever, pallor, and laboratory findings showing significant leukocytosis (63k), severe thrombocytopenia (27k), anemia, along with hepatosplenomegaly and lymphadenopathy, is highly specific for ALL. I have reached my limit of questions and tests.
